text_block_list.text:
I spotted Cesario and Air Messiah peering
into a magazine with serious looks on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Something for daily use would be best, right?
Like high-end hand cream...?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I think it's not bad.
...But since we're going to the trouble of giving a gift, maybe we want something with a bit more impact...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: Hello. What are you two discussing?
Hello. What are you two discussing?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I'm thinking of a present for my mother.
Right, Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was thinking of sending something to my respected mother as well.
choice_data_list: Huh, so it's not a birthday present or anything?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to show my daily gratitude.
I'm always receiving so much from you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But,
nothing really feels like the right fit to me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, we first talked about how a massage
chair might be nice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Both of our mothers are instructors at the training club, running with the kids every day... so I was hoping we could help relieve their fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still... it just feels so cliché,
so I can't help wondering if it's really okay.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So, standard health goods and the like
were all ruled out as candidates...

The two seem unable to find a breakthrough.
If it's an everyday token of gratitude, something more familiar and relatable to a parent and child might be better.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what's that thing you always get?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...In a single word, a dream.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was given the grand dream
of becoming a 'foundation for future umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The way to run that Mom taught me, her passion for racing, and all the care she gave me—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
All of those gifts that I received
were what shaped my dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I received my dream, too.
From watching my mother's back.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That the future we forged is magnificent—
may glory rest upon her shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... As a daughter, I want to prove my strength.
Through victory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems we both received something.
Something invisible to the eye, without physical form...
and yet, deeply precious.
choice_data_list: Then... maybe something intangible would be better.
Then... maybe something intangible would be better.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Something... without a physical form...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—...gh, of course! A return gift
doesn't necessarily have to be a physical object!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be...
Fufu, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well done, it seems Messiah understands as well.
That's right—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Showing myself having achieved my dream.
...Isn't that right, Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. What we are receiving isn't something tangible.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So, if I am to express my gratitude, it should likewise be with something formless—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Reaching beyond what you were given...
That's what it means, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think it's the perfect gift
Yeah, I think it's the perfect gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Whew, we've finally settled on it.
...Or rather, perhaps this was the only answer
from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that makes sense.
No wonder the two of you lost your way.

A wall standing before her, yet also a peer
who shares the same high perspective—
that presence must be truly reassuring for Cesario.
choice_data_list: Hope we can send it soon.
Hope you can send it soon.
It's a long road, but let's keep running!

text_block_list.text:
A wall standing before her, yet also a peer
who shares the same high perspective—
that presence must be truly reassuring for Cesario.
choice_data_list: Hope we can send it soon.
Hope you can send it soon.
It's a long road, but let's keep running!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can hardly wait.
I'm sure they'll be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
For that as well, we must steadily do what we can right now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
With gratitude in our hearts, let's grow stronger, one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer.
Until the day I can deliver this gift, my legs will not stop.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Becoming the person who can achieve her dream...
the person I want to show Mother,
is by no means an easy task.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
No matter how much time it takes, without fail.
Let us press on, unwavering.
